name: Kitakata Kazune
source:
A classmate of Itsuki, she is a member of the literary club. She is not good at talking to people and usually spends her time reading alone at school.
[spoiler]Her love for light novels started when she read the works of the author [url=https://vndb.org/c13504]Suzushiro Rein[/url], and currently she posts her own novels online under the pen name "Bokke waon." Itsuki and Kazune hit it off because Itsuki was a fan of "Bokke waon". Kazune confides in Itsuki about her dream of becoming a novelist, which she had never revealed to anyone, and discusses her concerns about possibly being a victim of stalking. Gradually, Itsuki becomes a source of emotional support for her.[/spoiler]
[translated from digital setting materials]
